name: fk
description: Read the current Figma browser selection through the local FigLens bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Read Figma frames from the browser.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local read-only FigLens reader so any task can inspect the selected Figma frame or a node from a Figma URL.
defaultPrompt: Prepare the selected frame for implementation in the current project.
